text: Session auto-cleanup cron — old app deleted submitted sessions >24h. New app keeps everything. Add cleanup.
API authentication — role-based auth so workers can't close shifts and foremen can't run payroll.
100% unit test coverage by April 15th — backend (70 tests), mobile (0 tests). Need full coverage.
Web dashboard — farm owners need browser-based management UI. Dashboard, Employee, Payroll, Login pages. Biggest feature gap.
Push notifications — notify workers when foreman opens session, foremen when workers check in.
WebSocket real-time updates — Socket.io for check-in events. Add when web dashboard exists.
Liquid attestation for attendance proof — equivalent of old ERC-721 AttendanceNFTs on Liquid.
Real Liquid SDK integration (GDK) — replace simulated assets with actual Blockstream GDK calls.
Real Lightning node (LNbits mainnet or LDK) — demo mode can't actually pay workers.
Offline-first with local SQLite sync — critical for real farms.
